evidence: The crystallinity and surface morphology of the SnO2 films were studied by XRD and AFM. According to the XRD data, the films were always polycrystalline cassiterite-type with some variations in the preferred orientation. The AFM studies furnish two types of data, grain size and surface roughness. According to AES and SIMS measurements, the layers formed did not contain impurities except some traces of chlorine and carbon; the oxygen and tin depth distributions proved to be homogeneous. The electrical resistivity of the films was measured by the four-point probe method in air at room temperature.
